response.sql: WITH order_counts AS (SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM `order` GROUP BY account_id), differences AS (SELECT account_id, order_count, order_count - AVG(order_count) OVER () AS difference FROM order_counts) SELECT d.account_id, district.A3 AS region, d.order_count, d.difference FROM differences AS d JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = d.account_id JOIN district ON district.district_id = a.district_id ORDER BY d.difference DESC, d.account_id ASC LIMIT 10
